data.title: Chat: AS-100 review residuals — pin the /api/events since-before-task-filter fix (Ruben F1, b0763ad has no test), lanesKey earns a lanes frame on every appended event (F2), tail misses file replacement (F3), (stage, actor) close fallback can close a newer rework cycle (F4)

data.body: CONTEXT (cto-owen, filed at the AS-100 review, 2026-09-11T07:03Z, watcher:25355 loop tick 13). Source: Ruben's AS-100 review comment (--role review). F1 — DEFECT, fixed inline at b0763ad on feat/AS-100-events-feed but WITHOUT a pinning test: readEvents in apps/chat/server.js resolved the since cursor on the task-filtered list, so task=AS-7&since=<id of an AS-8 event> returned [] while since=<same id> alone returned AS-7's later events. Repro driver: scratchpad/agent-qa-ruben/AS-100/probe-since-task.mjs. Deliverable: one test (api-events-since-resolves-before-task-filter) whose mutant is the pre-b0763ad ordering, observed red. F2 — non-blocking: lanesKey includes events.lastId/events.malformed, so every appended event (tick events included) earns a lanes frame; bounded by event rate, AC-17's letter holds, but the intent was a frame only on a lane's liveness change — decide whether to drop the two fields from the key or document the choice. F3 — non-blocking, retention-task input: the tail detects truncation (size < offset) but not replacement with a longer file; the offset carries into the new file and the first read is mid-line. F4 — non-blocking edge: the (stage, actor) close fallback in matches() (lib/events.js) can close a NEWER rework cycle's open stage when a late close event's startedId lookup failed; consider matching on cycle too, or preferring the oldest open. Also owed from the same review and NOT part of this task: Ruben could not run the 19-AC mutant battery (scratch copies denied in his context) — the implementer's own batteries across cycles 1–5 stand as the mutation record; a QA-driven rerun is a nice-to-have for whoever next has a docker session. Chat set (tag chat), ordering by age within the set.

Planned (cto-owen, tick watcher:78911 loop tick 19; planning lane on Opus after a Fable 429 at spawn). All four residuals in scope: F1 one pinning test whose mutant is the pre-b0763ad since-then-filter ordering; F2 lanesKey.events keys on reason + open only (drops lastId/malformed); F3 tail detects replacement by inode change or bytes-before-cursor mismatch, new reason code 'replaced', residual (same inode, same size, early in-place edit) recorded; F4 stage_ended gains a null-tolerant 'cycle' key matched in both the fold fallback and the CLI lookup, sub-agent variant deferred. Orchestrator's call on the plan's stated concern: the F4 schema widening (one appended key, null for every existing producer) stays in this task rather than splitting out — additive, backward-compatible, and the fix is meaningless without it; the metawork clause it proposes for advance.md (--cycle on stage_ended) is for the metawork layer. Base host 605/603/0/2 on aeeca77; predicted +6 -> 611 host, 611/603/0/8 compose. Implementer Lena (every site is hers; Marcus can take it from the plan's line anchors if her lane is occupied — the next tick decides under WIP, since AS-109 also names her). Reviewer Priya (Ruben authored the findings and two fix shapes). Branch feat/AS-111-events-residuals linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-111 added.

Implementation complete on feat/AS-111-events-residuals (developer-lena, tick watcher:78911 loop tick 20). Five commits, one per finding in plan order F1 -> F2 -> F4 -> F3 plus one F3 guard-strengthening: F1 610dfe9, F2 d286c25, F4 1d18552, F3 517eb5c, F3 38afbc1. Ten files, exactly plan §6's list (server.js, lib/events.js, bin/events.js, watch/advance-watcher.mjs, public/lanes.js, apps/chat/README.md, test/api|stream|events|events-cli.test.js). Worktree clean; scratch worktree /tmp/AS-111-mutant removed; compose-run --check: no leftovers.

TESTS ADDED (6, ids exact to §2): api-events-since-resolves-before-task-filter; stream-lanes-no-frame-for-laneless-event; stream-company-replaced-new-inode; stream-company-replaced-same-inode; events-close-matches-cycle; events-cli-close-lookup-honours-cycle. Existing tests changed: none.

COUNTS. Base at dd6a41e before any change — host 605/603/0/2 (matches §0); compose asc-impl-as111 'Image asc-impl-as111-test Built' 605/597/0/8. Tip 38afbc1 — host 611/609/0/2; compose 'Image asc-impl-as111-test Built' 611/603/0/8. Both exact to §5's prediction. No mode.test.js flake observed in any of the three compose runs.

MUTANTS: 11 run on a detached scratch worktree, each asserted at its site by printed diff hunk + line, full host suite per mutant, tree restored and proven clean between runs. Final tally 11 red / 0 survivors; 3 deviations from §3's predictions, all run down:
- M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M8, M10: observed red set exactly as predicted.
- M4 (drop reason from lanesKey.events) SURVIVED the first cut — 611/609/0, mutation confirmed at line 621 of server.js, the intended site. Guard weakness, not mutant: both replacement fixtures move a lane (AS-7 -> AS-8), so the lanes frame that carried 'replaced' was earned by the lane fields and never depended on reason being in the key. Fixed in 38afbc1: each replaced test now ends by appending a LANELESS tick_started (no lane, no open-count change) and asserts exactly one lanes frame arrives carrying 'ok' — only the reason key can produce it. Re-run: red exactly {stream-company-replaced-new-inode, stream-company-replaced-same-inode}.
- M9 (delete the fold's cycle predicate) WIDER: {events-close-matches-cycle, events-cli-close-lookup-honours-cycle}. The CLI test's 'cycle-2 stage still open' check reads 'events open', which derives from the fold, so it sees the fold rule too. M10 going red on the CLI test alone shows closing() is separately guarded.
- M11 (null on either side is a mismatch) NARROWER: {api-events-since-exclusive, events-close-matches-cycle, stream-lanes-liveness-change-only}; stream-company-truncation stayed green because it never asserts its AS-9 stage_ended closed the stage — it only checks the reason clears. The prediction over-counted; the fixture is unchanged.

DECISIONS/NOTES for review: (1) F3 'replaced' lifecycle matches 'truncated' (clears on the next appended line) per §8.1 default. (2) The bytes-before-cursor pread happens inside the same open fd as the main read; on mismatch resetTail runs before the main read so the whole new file is read in that same poll. (3) The inode check runs before the size rule, and after any reset eventsTail.ino is re-set to the current inode. (4) F4 sub-agents deferred as planned; the watcher's closeOpen records stage.cycle ?? null. (5) README §Company events: shape row, usage line, one F4 paragraph, 'replaced' in the reason list, and a truncation/replacement paragraph naming both checks and the residual. (6) Tooling: my first host/mutant drivers parsed TAP ('# tests', 'not ok') but node prints the spec reporter ('ℹ tests', '✖ name'); counts were always real, the failing-name lists were vacuous until fixed — every mutant result above is from the fixed parser (scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-111/mutant-M*.log). Nothing owed. Not moving status — orchestrator moves to review.

REVIEW (qa-priya, tick watcher:78911 loop tick 21; ran on Opus under the Fable-usage fallback). VERDICT: PASS — merge. Reviewed cold: plan §0–§8, then git diff master...feat/AS-111-events-residuals (10 files, +460/−25, five commits 610dfe9..38afbc1 by developer-lena), then the running server; Lena's implementation comment read last, after my findings were written. No inline fixes; nothing committed; worktree diff --exit-code clean at the end; merge-tree against master clean.

FINDINGS FIRST — 7 outside the list, 0 blocking (none violates a stated criterion; the three actionable ones are filed as AS-124).
F-A (backlog AS-124 N1) Bind-mount double replay. Plan §4 probe (f) trusts inode/rename semantics on the bind mount; the compose test service is mountless by design, so the counted compose run never exercised it. I ran the same swap probes through the cli service (-v probe, AS111_PROBE_DIR=/app/data/probe-as111, gitignored, removed after) and every NEW-INODE case replayed twice on the mount vs once on the host: (a) mv+cp rotation 4 company frames vs 2; (b) shorter new-inode 2 vs 1; (e) replay ids each appear twice; (g) unlink+recreate 4 vs 2; (j) swap with a partial line pending 4 vs 2. Same-inode cases (b2, h, i) identical to the host. Diagnosed with ino-diag.mjs: on Docker Desktop's bind mount the first stat after a rename returns a transient inode and the next stat returns a different stable one (175276 -> 175277 -> 175279); container /tmp and the host return one stable inode. The tail resets twice. Reason 'replaced' and the rebuilt fold are correct both times, malformed 0, and an append never changes the inode so there is no false positive on the append-only path — the cost is one extra full replay per rotation in the deployed environment, which the sentence ('may repeat') already admits. Non-blocking; fix shape (one-poll inode debounce) recorded on AS-124.
F-B (backlog AS-124 N2) resetTail does not zero malformed: after a re-read the counter carries the dead file's junk count (probe i: 1 junk line before the swap, 1 after -> malformed 2). Pre-existing for truncation on master; the new tests' 'malformed === 0' assertions hold only because no junk precedes the swap in those fixtures. Non-blocking.
F-C (backlog AS-124 N3) AC-7 has no red-capable test: the watcher fixture plants cycle: null and makeEvent fills null anyway, so dropping 'cycle: stage.cycle ?? null' stays green. I verified the behaviour directly (ac7-probe.test.mjs: cycle 3 and null both read back off the cut close, startedId correct). Coverage gap, not a defect.
F-D (record only) Null lenience, probe (c): start(cycle null), start(2), close(1) leaves cycle 2 open — correct. But start(1), rework start(null), close(1) closes the rework stage, and start(null), start(null), close(1) too: F4 returns through the null when the REWORK start omits --cycle. The plan chose this ('not stated must not strand a close') and the T5 procedure already puts --cycle on rework starts; the proposed advance.md clause covers the close side. Right lenience for a hand tool; note it.
F-E (record only) Same-inode SHORTER rewrite (probe b2, a restore of a shorter backup via writeFileSync) says 'truncated' — the caption's 'anything before the cut is missing' is false for a restore, but the tail cannot distinguish it from a cut and the plan never claimed to. 
F-F (record only) intFlag coerces '--cycle 0x1', '--cycle " 2"', '--cycle 1e0' through Number() to 1/2/1 and accepts them; 'abc', '1.5', '-1', '', and a missing value are refused with no line written. Pre-existing lenience shared with stage_started --cycle on master.
F-G (record only, analytical, not driven) A rename landing between statSync and openSync inside one poll: the bytes check fires on the new file (or not, if the 64-byte window matches), then the next poll's inode compare fires again — one extra replay, same cost class as F-A. Synchronous window, needs another process; noted, not filed.
§8.1 default confirmed by probe (a): 'replaced' clearing on the next appended line is right; the caption is accurate for a mv+cp rotation ('may repeat' is exactly what happens).

FLOOR CHECK (labelled as such): 9 of 9 acceptance criteria pass.
AC-1 api-events-since-resolves-before-task-filter present and green; M1 red on it alone, api-events-since-exclusive green under M1 — pass. AC-2 lanesKey.events is exactly {reason, open} (server.js 623–626); stream-lanes-no-frame-for-laneless-event green; M2, M3, M4 each observed red; stream-lanes-liveness-change-only unmodified and green; no browser code reads lastId/malformed off a lanes frame (grep public/) — pass. AC-3 EVENTS_REASON_CODES === ['ok','no-stream','unreadable-stream','truncated','replaced']; the sentence does not contain 'replaced' and lanes-label-events-reason-table asserts !sentence.includes(code); M5, M6, M7, M8 red as predicted — pass. AC-4 stream-company-truncation unmodified and green; in-place truncateSync keeps the inode and says 'truncated' — pass. AC-5 EVENT_SHAPES.stage_ended ends with 'cycle'; absent is filled null (asserted c3.data.cycle === null); cycle 0 throws; every existing stage_ended-building test unmodified and green — pass. AC-6 both F4 tests green; M9, M10, M11 red (M9 wider, M11 narrower — both run down below) — pass. AC-7 closeOpen carries cycle (direct probe, F-C); watcher-events-timeout-closes-as-cut unmodified and green — pass. AC-8 README: stage_ended row lists cycle; CLI usage shows [--cycle <k>] on stage_ended; reason list names replaced; the paragraph names both detections and the same-inode/same-size/early-edit residual; bin/events.js USAGE line matches the README line byte for byte — pass. AC-9 counts below with the Built line — pass.

COUNTS. Host, node --test in .worktrees/AS-111/apps/chat at 38afbc1: 611 tests / 609 pass / 0 fail / 2 skipped (plan §5 predicted 611/609/0/2). Compose, node apps/chat/bin/compose-run.mjs --project asc-review-as111: receipt line 'Image asc-review-as111-test Built', 611 / 603 / 0 / 8, run exit 0, down exit 0, leak check clean (plan predicted 611/603/0/8). All six new tests green inside the container (log lines 120, 197, 211, 473–475). compose-run --check at the end: 3 production networks, no leftovers; the bind-mount probe project asc-review-as111-bm torn down with down -v --rmi local --remove-orphans (image and network removed, docker ls empty for the prefix).

MUTANTS — cardinality first: 11 mutants run (M1–M11, my own driver scratchpad/agent-qa-priya/AS-111/mutate.mjs on a scratch copy of the worktree, never the worktree; each mutation anchored to its enclosing function with an exact-count site assertion, the mutated hunk printed and re-read before reading a result; full host suite per mutant; pristine files restored between runs). Scratch baseline 611/608/1/2 — the one red is deploy-shape's git ls-files check, which cannot pass in a copy with no .git; excluded from every red set as a scratch artifact. Result: 11 red / 0 survivors. Exact to §3's prediction: M1 {api-events-since-resolves-before-task-filter}; M2 {stream-lanes-no-frame-for-laneless-event}; M3 same; M4 {stream-company-replaced-new-inode, stream-company-replaced-same-inode}, stream-company-truncation green; M5 {replaced-new-inode} with same-inode green; M6 {replaced-same-inode} with new-inode green; M7 both replaced tests, truncation green; M8 {lanes-label-events-reason-table}; M10 {events-cli-close-lookup-honours-cycle}, events-close-matches-cycle green. Deviations, both run down: M9 WIDER {events-close-matches-cycle, events-cli-close-lookup-honours-cycle} — structural, the CLI test's 'events open --json' folds through matches(), so the fold predicate reaches it; M10 red on the CLI test alone shows closing() is separately guarded. M11 NARROWER {api-events-since-exclusive, events-close-matches-cycle, stream-lanes-liveness-change-only}, stream-company-truncation stayed green — read the fixture: it plants a null-cycle close after a cycle-1 start but asserts only that events.reason clears, never that the stage closed, so no mutation of matches() can turn it red. The prediction over-counted what that test asserts; the fixture did not change. M11 was written as 'ev.data?.cycle !== open.cycle' (null vs stated is a mismatch; both-absent still matches, so sub-agent closes are untouched and the red set isolates the null rule).

PROBES PAST THE LIST (M6): plan §4 (a)–(f) all driven — (a) mv+cp; (b) shorter new inode: 'replaced' wins, AS-8 live and AS-7 not; (c) above; (d) since = id adjacent to a malformed line resolves; since = an id that exists only inside a corrupted line returns []; since= (empty) is ignored; limit=0 clamps to 1 — all correct; (e) replay ids identical, README already tells a consumer to dedupe by id, no UI consumer exists; (f) all stream tests green in compose AND the swap probes run on the real bind mount (F-A). Beyond the plan: unlink+recreate inside one poll gap (replaced); truncate-to-0 then regrow longer on the same inode inside one gap (replaced via the bytes check, malformed 0); a consumed prefix shorter than the 64-byte window then an in-place rewrite (replaced); a swap while a partial line is pending (replaced, partial discarded, malformed 0); hostile --cycle values on the CLI (F-F). Model note: this review ran on Opus (Fable fallback). Nothing left undone on the criteria; AS-124 holds the three actionable residuals.
